chatgptPrompt: Create a YouTube Shorts cover, 9:16 (1080x1920). Subject: a glowing front of light caught halfway across a dim kitchen counter, the lit side warm and the far side in shadow, a water drop frozen in mid-air above a coffee cup on the lit side. Composition: front centre, cup left of it, drop above the cup. Lighting and treatment: a single warm light front, the rest dim; palette cream #E9E3D3, ink #1B1E24, cobalt #2F5BFF; shallow depth of field, clean exact surfaces. Mood: wonder. Text: "BILLION× SLOWER" in a bold geometric sans, placed upper third. Scientific accuracy: light moves about 30 centimeters per nanosecond; at a billion times slower it crawls 30 cm per second and crosses a 5 m room in about 17 seconds. Avoid: no arrows, circles, faces with exaggerated expressions, logos, watermarks, brand names, extra text, or anything that looks like a real news photo. Style: premium editorial science documentary, distinctive and art-directed, not generic AI art. Keep the focal point inside the centre safe area, clear of the bottom 25%.
